label: LightONKaroo
description: Manual ANT+ and Bluetooth bike light control for Hammerhead Karoo 3 with Software Threat Mode, iGPSPORT and Magene BLE smart light support.
releaseNotes:
* Magene BLE Smart Light Stack: Dedicated Magene BLE controller supporting AT1200, AT1600 & L508 with 7 Custom Slots (0-100% sliders)
* Dynamic Day/Night Mode UI: Crisp black text in Day Mode (Light Theme) and glowing white text in Night Mode (Dark Theme)
* 7 Custom Slots for iGPSPORT, Magicshine & Magene: 0-100% sliders with pattern selection & disk persistence
* UI Polish: Intuitive expand/collapse arrow (▼/▲) icon, clean 2-line battery level layout, and high-contrast styling
